        # Test joining multiple language scopes.
        # By default, they intersect. Join ORs them.
        python_code = """
    def my_func():
        x = "hello"
        # comment
    """

        code, stdout, stderr = run_executable(["--python", "strings", "--python", "comments", "--upper"], input_str=python_code)
